messages:
Nadia: Quick follow-up on Private controlplane pairing semantics. Weve had a couple customer reports where NAT/retries caused token redemption confusion. Need a clear, idempotent flow.
Ben: Proposal: one-time token used to mint a pairing-id + certs. If client retries, server SHOULD return the same pairing-id rather than 4xx. That makes retries safe.
Carlos: Implementation detail: perform a create-if-not-exists keyed by token (or retry-id). If record exists, return existing pairing. DB must support conditional put to avoid races.
Tess: We need a cheap verify path for clients that timed out: GET /pairings/{pairing-id} -> {pending|ready|failed} + cert metadata when ready. Avoid heavy lookups.
Nadia: Security: pairing-id must be unguessable (HMAC(token||client_nonce||ts)). Do NOT bind to client IP (breaks NAT). Optionally include TLS public key fingerprint for additional assurance.
Ben: Retry dedupe: clients should send a Retry-UUID header. Server keeps a short-lived dedupe window (default 2m) for retry-uuids per token and returns previous response when duplicate seen.
Carlos: TTL defaults: token validity 60s, dedupe window 2m, pairing lookup window 5m. Make configurable per-tenant; opt-in up to 24h for flaky networks.
Tess: Error codes: 409 (redeemed but pairing returned), 410 (token expired), 404 (verify unsupported on old CP), 202 (accepted/pending), 200 (ready).
Nadia: SDK contract sketch: pairing.start(token, {client_nonce}) -> returns pairing_id or throws; pairing.verify(pairing_id) polls verify endpoint; sdk auto-retry with backoff + jitter and exposes fallback_to_relay flag.
Ben: Ops: emit metrics pairing.attempts, pairing.success, pairing.dedupe_hits, pairing.pending_reconciliations. Alert if success rate < 99% for 15m.
Carlos: Storage: token->pairing mapping with TTL index; separate pairing table for status and cert blobs. Use conditional writes for idempotency.
Tess: Reconciliation: background job for pending pairings that retries cert apply and transitions state to ready/failed. Admins need a revoke API: POST /admin/tenants/{id}/pairings/revoke.
Nadia: Key rotation: KMS-backed signing keys, automated weekly rotation with 1h verification grace. Document grace window and rollback steps.
Ben: Rollout plan: spike in staging with lenient mode (48h), then gradual region-by-region flip behind feature flags. Communicate SDK changes and provide a 2-week deprecation window for older clients.
Carlos: Edge-case: server accepted token but crashed before writing pairing record. Conditional DB create keyed by token or retry-id prevents duplicates; client will get same pairing on retry.
Tess: UX: make pairing.verify cheap and cacheable in SDK to reduce load. If verify 404s, sdk falls back to token-probing and logs telemetry event.
infra-bot: Staging preview: https://staging.internal/pairings (expires in 2h)
Nadia: Next steps: Ill write the brief RFC with the state machine, sample SDK snippets, and runbook changes. Target: EOD tomorrow.
Ben: Ill build a NAT-flap test harness for validation.
Carlos: Ill prototype the conditional-write flow and metrics.
